dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Welcome. A good cup of coffee will keep you energized all day.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: This is Puspa Café, and I'm the acting manager here.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: If you're a first-time customer, why don't you tell me what your preferences are? Then I can recommend a coffee that will suit your tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Do you like your coffee sweet, or do you prefer it more on the bitter side? Stronger or milder?

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Whatever your preferences, no matter how offbeat, I can make something to your liking.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Ah, you must have spotted Gata.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Gata's not even a year old yet so she's still a very curious kitty. Whenever I read people's fortunes from the coffee grounds, she'll jump up to watch.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: If you'd like, you can give her head a good pat. She'll get happy and start purring, and you'll get to enjoy the softest feeling in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Take care, hope to see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Are you fond of desserts? We have some that go very well with coffee. Please, feel free to try some!

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Haha, looks like you are a cat lover, too.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Here's a tip for you, my friend! Gata prefers Fowl to Fish.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: If Gata eats the Fowl you feed her, then she must be willing to be your friend!
